note: Every image the site can display, and where it came from. Drive is the source of truth for Masinloc photography: assets/ holds only files supplied by the project. scripts/check-photography.py fails the build if a page references an image that is not listed here, or if any page pulls an image from an external host.
rules: No stock photography: Unsplash, Pexels, Shutterstock, Getty or similar.
No image may be relabelled as a place it does not show.
Presentation may be improved by cropping, overlay, layout, typography, motion and colour treatment. The physical identity of a place must not be altered.

cards.origin: Google Drive - Masinloc Website Asset / Location
cards.note: The finished 1:1 pubmats. Each already carries the logo, place name, description, things-to-do and tags, so it is used whole as the shareable card and never has type laid over it. Built at 600 and 1200px.

pending.mapping: Fixed in data/locations.json. Each raw photograph was matched against the photograph embedded in the correspondingly labelled pubmat, so the place name comes from the project's own labelling.

unassigned.decision: Not used. Cannot be tied to a named place, so it is never labelled as a location.

campaigns.origin: Google Drive - Masinloc Website Asset / Ads
campaigns.note: Approved campaign artwork. Each file is a finished design carrying its own logo, headline and copy, so it is shown whole and never cropped, retyped or regenerated. Mapping is fixed in data/campaigns.json; built by scripts/build-campaigns.py.

leadership.note: Painted official portraits of the Municipal Mayor and former Municipal Mayors of Masinloc, supplied by the project. Every portrait is cropped to the same 4:5, resized through the same width ladder and encoded at the same quality by scripts/build-leadership.py — no per-person crop, size, sharpening or retouching. Faces are never altered. Mapping is fixed in data/leadership.json.

connect.note: The Masinloc Connect hero. Not a photograph: a supplied brand graphic of the Masinloc mark on a navy field, circled by an orbit carrying the palette as nodes, with the left of the frame left empty for the headline. scripts/build-connect-hero.py produces two crops from the one original — the full 16:9 for landscape viewports, and a 4:5 crop around the orbit for phones, where cover on a 16:9 graphic would leave only an unrecognisable third of the mark. Nothing is upscaled and the artwork itself is never altered.

discover.origin: Google Drive - Masinloc Website Asset / Additional image
discover.note: Approved hero artwork for the Discover section, supplied by the project with the branded treatment already applied: the real photograph full-bleed, the official logo, the translucent geometric ribbons in yellow, red and blue, and where present a map-pin location label and footer line reading 'For Masinloqueños. With Masinloqueños. By Masinloqueños.' scripts/build-discover-assets.py only re-encodes and resizes them — nothing is cropped, reframed or retouched, because cropping would cut the logo, label or footer off finished artwork. Native aspect ratios are recorded in data/discover-assets.json and the pages are built around them. Per subject: pamislat — a hand holding one bivalve above a basin of them, labelled Pamislat. mangoes-masinloc — ripe mangoes in crates, carrying the supplied 'Masinloc, Zambales' label. dinamulag-mango — ripe dinamulag (carabao) mangoes in a crate, labelled Dinamulag Mango; no barangay is claimed for this one because the asset does not establish one. binabayani-festival — Binabayani performers in white with red and green sashes and ribboned headdresses, labelled Binabayani Festival. suman-and-mango — leaf-wrapped suman bundles with sliced ripe mango, labelled Masinloc Suman and Mangga; the label describes the plate photographed and is not treated on the page as a claim about a distinct local style. powerplant-bani — an aerial of the generating station, its stacks, coal jetty and the bay behind it, labelled Barangay Bani. Supplied 2026-08-25: binabayani-festival, suman-and-mango and powerplant-bani are new. pamislat and dinamulag-mango were replaced the same day with full-resolution re-exports of the same photographs — the originals were 12-23 MB and could not be retrieved when the section was first built, so those two had been derived from smaller copies (1290x761 and 1691x930). All six are now 1920x1080 native.

notfound.note: The artwork shown on the 404 page, supplied finished by the project: Binabayani performers photographed at a fiesta, darkened, with the official logo centred, the tricolour rule and the footer strip inside the frame. scripts/build-404-hero.py only re-encodes and resizes it; nothing is cropped, because a crop would cut the logo or the footer. Note that the message baked into the artwork reads “Maintenance on going”, which is not what a 404 means — the page carries its own message underneath rather than relying on the artwork to explain itself.

landingHero.origin: Google Drive - Masinloc Website Asset / Hero landing page
landingHero.note: The landing page hero: Binabayani performers crossing the plaza in front of San Andres Church during a Masinloc fiesta. Unlike the Connect, Discover and 404 artwork this arrives as a plain photograph with no logo, ribbons or baked-in text, so it is placed with object-fit like any editorial photograph — the frame moves, the photograph is not altered. Built by scripts/build-landing-hero.py. It replaces the aerial photograph as the homepage hero; that file is unchanged, still byte-locked, and still the share image for nine other pages.

marketplaceLogos.origin: Google Drive - Masinloc Website Asset / Marketplace Logo
marketplaceLogos.note: Business logos supplied by the businesses themselves for publication in the Marketplace. scripts/build-marketplace-logos.py only re-encodes and resizes them: nothing is cropped, because a logo is finished artwork and trimming it returns a mark the business did not design. Each is shown contained in a square frame at its native ratio. A logo is read before it is published. Adaler's Grazing Delights supplied one with two mobile numbers set into the artwork, and this site publishes no phone numbers, so it is held back rather than cropped — the decision is the owner's. data/marketplace-logos.json records which have been reviewed and cleared.
